LanguageData.SmokeleafJoint.label: hemp joint
LanguageData.SmokeleafJoint.description: Hemp leaves prepared in small rolls for smoking. The drug improves mood, but also increases appetite, reduces focus and slows movement. Hemp use can produce a dependency.\n\nJoints can be produced at a crafting spot without equipment, and are a fixture in many traditional low-industriousness cultures.
LanguageData.Plant_Smokeleaf.label: hemp plant
LanguageData.Plant_Smokeleaf.description: A leafy crop grown for the psychological effects of chemicals in its leaves. Hemp leaves can be prepared into joints at the crafting spot. Hemp makes a user feel relaxed, but reduces motivation, and can be addictive.
LanguageData.SmokeleafLeaves.label: hemp leaves
LanguageData.SmokeleafLeaves.description: Raw cut leaves of a hemp plant. Can be rolled into smokeable joints at a crafting spot.
